# INDENA: PHYTOSOME® FOR SPORTS NUTRITION  
#### Click[HERE](https://www.teknoscienze.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/INDENA_CS_AF2_2019.pdf)to download the PDF version  
PHYTOSOME®, INDENA’S PROPRIETARY 100% FOOD-GRADE BIOMIMETIC DELIVERY SYSTEM  
Within its research activity devoted for years to medicinal plants, Indena has developed some of the most innovative products and technologies on the market. One of them is Phytosome®, Indena’s proprietary 100% food-grade biomimetic delivery system, the result of a wide experience and deep knowledge in product and process research.  
As botanical nutraceuticals and natural compounds are often provided with poor water solubility and limited intestinal absorption which usually hamper from addressing significant oral bioavailability, Indena pioneered and developed Phytosome® delivery system to optimize the bioabsorption of selected botanicals.
